title: Release the LPM product (maintainers)
description: Use only inside the LPM product repository (lpm), for LPM maintainers shipping to production (implantar em produção): worktree, checks, candidate deploy, promotion and smoke. Not for activity delivery (use lpm-deliver-activity).
doneWhen: The promoted revision serves all traffic and the smoke passed.
authorityCeiling: Process skill; stops on any failed check.
jobs: run the smoke after the deploy
implantar a nova versão em produção

routing.stopText: Deploying the LPM product is an LPM-maintainer procedure. Ask an LPM maintainer.

codex.shortDescription: Ship the LPM product with candidate and smoke
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-release-product to ship the LPM product.
